title: Il humilie le vieux sommelier : sa chute brutale

scenes.narration: Il arrose ce sommelier de vin. Grosse erreur. Victor, héritier arrogant, méprise le Domaine de Valrose. Il s’essuie les lèvres et traite ce millésime légendaire de piquette infâme.
scenes.visual: Cinematic vertical shot inside a vaulted stone wine cellar. Victor, a 28-year-old man with slicked-back dark hair in an expensive charcoal tailored suit, sneers maliciously as he splashes dark red wine from a glass toward Antoine, a 52-year-old man with salt-and-pepper short hair, a neat grey beard, wearing a rolled-sleeved white shirt and a worn dark-brown leather cellar apron.

scenes.narration: Le vin pourpre coule sur le tablier d’Antoine. Victor ricane, claque un dossier sur un vieux fût et exige de signer immédiatement le rachat du domaine avec le propriétaire.
scenes.visual: Medium close-up in the rustic cellar. Dark red wine drips down Antoine's worn dark-brown leather cellar apron over his white shirt. Antoine, 52, salt-and-pepper hair and neat grey beard, stares back with unwavering calm and dignity while Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair in his charcoal suit, slams a black contract folder onto an antique oak barrel.

scenes.narration: « Dégage, l'ivrogne. Dès que j'ai signé, tu es viré. » Victor brandit un chèque de trente millions. Pour lui, Antoine n’est qu'un ouvrier minable bon pour la rue.
scenes.visual: Dramatic angle focusing on Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair, charcoal tailored suit, waving a multi-million bank check with a condescending grin. Behind him in the dim cellar lighting, Antoine, 52, salt-and-pepper short hair and neat grey beard, stands tall and motionless in his rolled-sleeved white shirt and brown leather apron.

scenes.narration: Antoine essuie calmement son tablier et compose un numéro. À l’autre bout du fil, son banquier privé exécute ses ordres. Aussitôt, le téléphone de Victor vibre violemment.
scenes.visual: Antoine, 52, salt-and-pepper short hair, neat grey beard, wearing his rolled-sleeved white shirt and dark-brown leather apron, speaks calmly into a modern smartphone with cold authority. Across the oak barrel, Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair in charcoal suit, freezes as his own phone lights up and vibrates in his hand.

scenes.narration: C’est son père, en panique totale. Leurs crédits bancaires sont coupés, leurs actions s'effondrent et leur groupe est racheté. Victor blêmit, sa main tremble.
scenes.visual: Tight portrait of Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair in charcoal suit, holding his phone to his ear. His haughty expression collapses into pure dread, his face pale and sweating, as the paper check slips from his shaking fingers in the dim wine cellar.

scenes.narration: Antoine range son téléphone. C’est lui, le maître légendaire du domaine et l'actionnaire secret qui finançait leur empire. Il vient d'ordonner leur révocation totale.
scenes.visual: Low-angle powerful shot of Antoine, 52, salt-and-pepper short hair, neat grey beard, looking down with sovereign calm in his crisp white shirt and dark-brown leather apron. Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair in his charcoal suit, staggers back against towering wooden wine racks, clutching his chest in horror.

scenes.narration: Victor s'effondre à genoux, suppliant le maître. Antoine verse le reste du vin sur le chèque au sol et lui montre la sortie. Et vous, vous auriez ruiné sa famille ? Abonne-toi pour une nouvelle histoire chaque jour. Souviens-toi que tout a commencé quand...
scenes.visual: Wide cinematic scene. Victor, 28, slicked-back dark hair, charcoal tailored suit, is collapsed on his knees on the stone floor, looking up in complete despair. Antoine, 52, salt-and-pepper hair, neat grey beard, white shirt and brown leather apron, points firmly toward the cellar exit as dark red wine soaks the discarded check on the floor.

caption: Cet héritier arrogant pensait pouvoir humilier un simple artisan sans conséquences. Et vous, vous auriez ruiné sa famille ?
niche: Mini-drames originaux en français, dans l'esprit des mini-séries à succès : milliardaire caché, humiliation suivie d'une revanche, belle-famille cruelle, mariage arrangé ou sous contrat, trahison, secret de famille, retour triomphal des années plus tard
